verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a sandbox or test environment for Adyen Risk Management. The closest items are adjacent and do not count. Risk Rule Backtesting is a dry-run against historical (production) data, not an isolated sandbox. A/B risk experiments run on live traffic. Postman guidance is a developer building block, not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
